name: toolrow-chevron-nowrap
description: An intent-bearing tool row (the plain-trigger branch read_file/grep rows use: intent on line 1, demoted summary on line 2) keeps its trailing disclosure chevron on the intent's LAST text line at every swept column width - a line that fills exactly moves the chevron with the words it opens, never the glyph alone onto a wrapped line of its own. Each column sweeps a 20-width ladder so the case finds the binding widths wherever the platform's font metrics put them, and the assert requires that each sweep found at least one (last line within 18px of the column edge, intent wrapped to 2+ lines), so a font or platform change that moves the geometry fails the case instead of letting it pass vacuously.

mutation.declaration: ToolRow.tsx: the chevron rendered as a bare inline sibling after the intent text, with no atomic .intentTail unit around the final word (the harness's GLUED=false shape)
mutation.note: Verified with the final harness both ways on 2026-09-15: GLUED=false (the pre-fix bare inline chevron, this case's own first run) FAILs with the chevron stranded below the intent's last text line at every binding width the sweeps found (e.g. phone 374-388px, probe slack 1.6-15.6px); GLUED=true (production's .intentTail unit) PASSes all 151 widths per sweep with binding geometry still present. The equivalent CSS-only mutation (reverting .intentTail display:inline-flex to display:inline) strands the same way, per the identical secondaryTail mechanism verified on 2026-09-11 for notification-open-last-line.
